record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Are there axially symmetric static or stationary Einstein-Yang-Mills solutions that generalize the Kerr-Newman solution?

evidence.quote: (iv) find axially symmetric static or stationary solutions generalising the Kerr-Newman solution;

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Einstein–Yang–Mills equations on a 4-dimensional Lorentzian spacetime $(M,g)$ coupled to a non-abelian gauge connection $A$ with compact (e.g. $SU(2)$) structure group, namely
$$\mathrm{Ric}(g) - \tfrac{1}{2} R\, g = 8\pi T(F),\qquad d\!\star\! F + [A,\star F]=0,$$
where $F=dA+A\wedge A$ is the Yang–Mills curvature and $T(F)$ is its energy-momentum tensor. Assume the spacetime admits a timelike Killing field (stationarity), or is static, together with an axial Killing field generating $SO(2)$ symmetry, and contains a regular black-hole region with a non-degenerate Killing horizon and asymptotically flat exterior.

Question: Do there exist axially symmetric static or stationary asymptotically flat black-hole solutions of the Einstein–Yang–Mills system that genuinely generalize the Kerr–Newman family (in the sense of reducing to or playing the analogous role to Kerr–Newman when the gauge group is reduced to $U(1)$), having non-trivial non-abelian gauge field hair outside the horizon?
artifact.status_search_result: Static and stationary axially symmetric Einstein–Yang–Mills black hole solutions with non-abelian hair have been constructed numerically (e.g. by Kleihaus, Kunz and collaborators since the late 1990s), giving rotating EYM black holes that generalize Kerr-type configurations. However, a rigorous mathematical existence theory and a complete classification analogous to the Kerr–Newman family is still lacking, and the problem of constructing exact closed-form Kerr–Newman generalizations in EYM remains open.

status_evidence.title: Axially symmetric solutions in Einstein-Yang-Mills theory
status_evidence.snippet: Numerical construction of static axially symmetric SU(2) EYM black hole solutions beyond spherical symmetry.
status_evidence.claim: Axially symmetric EYM black hole solutions have been constructed numerically.

status_evidence.title: Rotating Einstein-Yang-Mills Black Holes
status_evidence.snippet: Stationary rotating non-abelian black holes with SU(2) gauge fields are constructed.
status_evidence.claim: Rotating EYM black holes generalizing Kerr-type rotating solutions exist numerically.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity (zbMATH 7363211)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists as an open problem: find axially symmetric static or stationary solutions generalising Kerr-Newman.
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open problem in mathematical relativity.
